blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We used medical image synthesis to create a challenging multimodal evaluation framework that exposes hallucination behaviors in frontier models. Evaluating multimodal reasoning has historically been difficult because existing medical datasets rarely pair different image modalities, such as radiographs and external clinical photographs. To address this gap, we introduce Trick-or-Treat, an adversarial multimodal medical benchmark that pairs real chest radiographs with synthetic clinical photographs to challenge models' cross-modal reasoning. For each of a wide range of conditions, we created two pairs of images, where the pairs share a single chest radiograph but contain different external photographs. In matched pairs, the chest radiograph and photograph both contain findings suggesting the same disease (e.g., varicella pneumonia suggested by lung opacities and crusted skin lesions seen in chickenpox). In mismatched pairs, the photograph depicts an alternative clinical finding that would not lead to the same unifying diagnosis (e.g. replacing crusted skin lesions with ordinary acne). Synthetic photograph generation allows clinical findings to be varied while the person's features and photographic setting stay consistent, reducing confounding. In an investigation of three frontier models, we found that models hallucinated clinically significant photograph findings in 45-57.5% of mismatched pairs, up from 25-37.5% for the same photographs shown alone. When faced with mismatched pairs, models tended to ignore mismatches and instead hallucinated findings that better matched the radiograph (e.g. misreading acne as crusted skin lesions to justify diagnosing chickenpox). Trick-or-Treat both demonstrates concerning error pattern in frontier models' medical reasoning and provides a proof of concept for the use of synthetic images in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们用医疗图像合成来创建具有挑战性的多模式评价框架,揭示前沿模型中的幻觉行为. 评估多式联运推理在历史上一直很困难,因为现有的医疗数据集很少对不同的图像模式,如放射图和外部临床照片. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了Trick-or-Treat,一种对抗性的多模式医学基准,将真实的胸腔放射图与合成临床照片配对,以挑战模型的跨模式推理. 对于每一个范围很广的条件,我们创造了两对图像,两对图像共用一个胸形放射图,但包含不同的外部照片. 在对应的对子中,胸腔放射图和照片都包含表明同一种疾病的发现(如肺部不透明和鸡瘟中出现皮壳损伤所暗示的阴道肺炎). 在不匹配的对子中,照片描绘了另一种临床发现,不会导致同样的统一诊断(如用普通的丙烯取代地壳皮肤损伤). 合成照片的生成可以使临床发现各异,而人物的特征和摄影设定则保持一致,减少困惑. 在对三个前沿模型的调查中,我们发现模型在45-57.5%的不匹配对子中产生了临床上重要的照片发现幻觉,而仅在这些照片中就出现了25-37.5%的幻觉。 当面对不匹配的对子时,模型往往忽略不匹配,而是幻觉地发现更符合放射图(例如误读丙烯为地壳皮肤损伤,以证明诊断鸡瘟的正当理由). Trick-or-Treat既演示了前沿模型医学推理的错误模式,也为在对抗性多式联运评价中使用合成图像提供了概念证明。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical vision-language models must be able to to reason over different medical image modalities and recognize when they tell a unified clinical story. As an example, consider a chest radiograph suggesting viral pneumonia and an external photograph of red, fluid-filled vesicles with varying levels of crusting, as seen in chickenpox. A model should notice that this pair of images is strongly suggestive a diagnosis of varciella pneumonia. In contrast, some medical images may be less of a “match,” providing no clear support for a unifying diagnosis. Accordingly, a model should not jump to a diagnosis of varicella pneumonia if the same radiograph from above is paired with a photograph of harmless pimples. Models that reason about multiple image modalities must succeed in both scenarios, suggesting a unified diagnosis when the evidence supports it while preserving accuracy and refraining from overdiagnosis in the face of less congruent inputs.
blocks.zh: 医学视觉语言模型必须能够通过不同的医学形象模式进行推理,并在讲述统一的临床故事时识别. 举例来说,考虑胸腔放射图暗示病毒性肺炎,以及红的,充满流体的冰囊的外照,其结壳水平不一,见于鸡尾花. 模型应该注意到,这对图像 强烈地暗示诊断出病毒性肺炎。 与此相反,一些医疗图像可能不那么“匹配”,没有为统一的诊断提供明确的支持。 因此,如果上面的同一幅放射图与无害皮条照片配对,模型就不应该跳到诊断阴道肺炎。 多种图像模式的理由必须在两种情景中取得成功的模型,建议在证据支持时进行统一诊断,同时保持准确性,避免在输入不一致的情况下进行过度诊断。

blocks.en: Past work has shown that models struggle to integrate multiple modalities, with conflicting textual cues reducing the accuracy of image interpretation [ 1 ] . Recent benchmarks have tested reasoning specifically on multiple image modalities by repurposing radiology teaching cases or specifically collecting multiple ophthalmic image modalities from hospitals [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . However, these approaches depend on existing case repositories or intensive clinical data acquisition, fundamentally constraining both the number of images available and the kinds of questions that can be asked. As a result, performing targeted evaluations across multiple image modalities remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 过去的工作表明,模型难以整合多种模式,文本提示相互冲突,降低了图像解释的准确性[1]. 最近的基准通过重新确定放射学教学案例或具体收集医院的多眼影像模型[2,3,4],对多种影像模式的推理进行了具体的测试. 然而,这些方法取决于现有的病例储存库或密集的临床数据采集,从根本上限制了现有图像的数量和可以问的问题的类型。 因此,在多种图像模式下进行目标明确的评价仍然是挑战。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Hallucination induced by a mismatched photograph–radiograph pair. In this example, GPT-6 Astra describes a benign port-wine stain correctly from the photo alone (top right), but when the same photo is paired with a chest radiograph suggestive of injury, it misinterprets the mark as flank ecchymosis (bottom right). Matched-pair photographs featuring true ecchymosis are interpreted correctly (left).
blocks.zh: 图1:一对不匹配的相片-射线照相机引起的幻觉。 在这个例子中,GPT-6 Astra只从照片(右上方)中正确描述了一个良性的端口-葡萄酒污点,但当同一照片与胸腔放射图对齐表明有损伤时,它将标记曲解为侧翼切除(右下方). 以真切性为特征的匹配-pair照片解释正确(左)。

blocks.en: In this work, we constructed Trick-or-Treat, a benchmark consisting of 40 real chest radiographs and 80 synthesized clinical photographs, to test multimodal reasoning with limited confounding. We paired each real chest radiograph with two generated clinical photographs: one showing a disease sign that supports a unified diagnosis and one showing an alternative finding that is less supportive. Using synthetic data, we kept the person’s features, pose, and background consistent across both photographs, even as the findings of interest change. Image synthesis also allowed us to present particularly subtle or challenging findings, increasing the difficulty level. This setup enabled the creation of a controlled, adversarial benchmark that probes model weaknesses.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们建造了Trick-or-Treat,这是一个由40张真实的胸腔射线图和80张综合临床照片组成的基准,以测试有限混淆的多式联运推理。 我们把每个真实的胸腔射线图配对了两个生成的临床照片:一个显示一个支持统一诊断的疾病标志,另一个显示一个支持性较低的替代发现. 使用合成数据,我们保持了人物的特征、姿势和背景在两张照片之间的一致性,即使随着兴趣结果的变化。 图像综合还使我们能够提出特别微妙或具有挑战性的结论,增加难度。 这种设置使得能够建立一个可控的,对抗性的基准来探测模型弱点.

blocks.en: Our benchmark poses multiple challenges for models. First, they must accurately interpret photographs showing diverse, sometimes subtle, findings. Second, they must maintain accuracy when each photograph is paired with a radiograph, which may or may not suggest a unifying diagnosis together. We found that three frontier models struggled with both elements. When analyzing a group of photographs in isolation without radiographs, models made clinically significant hallucinations in 25–37.5% of cases. When analyzing those same photographs together with mismatched radiographs, errors became even more frequent; models hallucinated clinically significant abnormalities in 45–57.5% of cases (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的基准对模型提出了多重挑战。 首先,他们必须准确解读显示各种、有时是微妙的调查结果的照片。 第二,在每张照片与放射图配对时,必须保持准确性,这可能意味着或不会意味着共同诊断。 我们发现,三个前沿模式都与这两个要素有冲突。 在分析一组没有放射图的隔离照片时,模型在25-37.5%的病例中产生了临床显著的幻觉. 在分析这些照片和不匹配的放射图时,误差变得更加频繁;模型在45-57.5%的病例中产生了临床上显著异常的幻觉(图1)。

blocks.en: This work makes two distinct contributions. The first is empirical: we demonstrate that three leading vision–language models made errors when interpreting clinical photographs, especially when those errors were consistent with contextual information. The second is methodological: we show that synthetic medical data can be used to construct controlled, adversarial tests of multimodal reasoning, despite the relative scarcity of multimodal medical datasets.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出了两项不同的贡献。 第一个是经验性:我们证明,三种主要的视觉-语言模型在解释临床照片时出错,特别是当这些错误与背景信息一致时。 第二是方法:我们表明,尽管多式联运医疗数据集相对稀缺,但合成医疗数据可用于构建对多式联运推理的有控制的对抗性测试。

blocks.en: 2  Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1  Synthetic medical photographs
blocks.zh: 2.1 合成医学照片

blocks.en:
Synthetic clinical photographs have been developed to address limited training data and variation in
disease appearance. DermGAN generates skin-condition images while controlling lesion size, location, and
skin color, and evaluates their use in classifier training [ 5 ] . Sagers et al. use DALL ⋅ \cdot E 2 to
generate dermatological photographs across skin types and study whether synthetic augmentation improves
classification for underrepresented populations [ 6 ] . LesionGen extends text-conditioned synthesis with
structured dermatological descriptions, enabling generation from clinically meaningful visual attributes
and evaluating downstream classification and subgroup performance [ 7 ] . Together, these studies establish
controllable synthesis of external disease appearances as a practical tool for medical machine learning.

blocks.en:
Cross-modal medical image synthesis predates the current generation of multimodal foundation models. Nie
et al. generate synthetic CT images from MRI of the same subject using context-aware generative
adversarial networks [ 8 ] . More recent work constructs richer synthetic patient representations. Chu and Goodell combine language,
visual avatars, and generated audio to simulate difficult patient conversations for medical education [ 9 ] .
XGeM supports synthesis across frontal chest radiographs, lateral chest radiographs, and radiology reports,
including generation of a missing view and joint generation of clinically coherent outputs [ 10 ] . Its image
pairs present different radiographic views, rather than different clinical modalities.
IMCBench pairs real dermatology photographs with synthetic patient profiles and EHR context to evaluate
image-grounded medical conversations [ 11 ] ; the photographs themselves are not generated, and the paired
channels are images and records rather than two image types. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first benchmark to use image synthesis to evaluate models’ medical reasoning on sets of images representing different imaging modalities.

blocks.en: 2.2  Adversarial medical evaluation and hallucination
blocks.zh: 2.2 横向医疗评估和幻觉

blocks.en:
Medical hallucination benchmarks show why conventional question-answering accuracy is insufficient to
establish reliable image interpretation. MedVH tests responses to mismatched images, clinically incorrect
questions, absent abnormalities, misleading answer suggestions, and report-generation tasks [ 12 ] . MedHEval
organizes hallucinations around visual misinterpretation, knowledge deficiency, and context misalignment,
using both closed- and open-ended medical questions to evaluate models and mitigation methods [ 13 ] . More
recently, Med-R2 evaluates visually grounded reasoning across stages of a clinical workflow and uses
adversarial perturbations to test robustness to misleading cues [ 14 ] . These benchmarks establish
complementary ways to ask whether medical models reject unsupported premises and ground their reasoning in
the available evidence.

blocks.en:
Synthetic counterfactual images can also expose model shortcuts. RoentMod edits chest radiographs to
introduce specified pathology while preserving unrelated anatomy, then uses these interventions to identify
reliance on off-target findings and improve model robustness [ 15 ] . Our construction applies a related
intervention across two image types: we held a real radiograph fixed and generated external photographs with narrow differences that can reveal model shortcuts.

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1  Matched cases
blocks.zh: 3.1 相应案件

blocks.en: The Trick-or-Treat benchmark focuses on 40 conditions, each represented by one matched image pair and a second mismatched image pair. Conditions include acute presentations, such as traumatic hemothorax, pulmonary contusion, and varicella pneumonia, as well as chronic or systemic conditions, such as systemic sclerosis, acromegaly, and Marfan syndrome. For each condition, we constructed a matched pair and a mismatched pair, combining a single chest radiograph with two different synthetic clinical photographs. In the matched pair, the photograph depicts findings associated with the same disease as the radiograph. In the mismatched pair, the photograph depicts an alternative finding that has little to no connection with that disease (Figure 2 ). Importantly, the mismatched photograph findings and radiograph findings can coexist in a patient, particularly one with multiple conditions; they just do not point to a clear, unifying diagnosis.
blocks.zh: Trick-or-Treat基准侧重于40个条件,每个条件由1对匹配的图像配对和2对不匹配的图像配对代表. 病情包括急性的演示,如创伤性出血,肺部挫伤,以及 Varicella肺炎,以及慢性或系统性的病症,如系统硬化,发作,和Marfan综合征. 对于每个情况,我们构建了匹配的对和不匹配的对,结合了单胸放射图和两种不同的合成临床照片. 在配对中,照片描绘了与放射图相同的疾病相关的发现. 在不匹配的配对中,照片描绘了一种与这种疾病几乎没有联系的替代发现(图2)。 重要的是,不匹配的照片发现和放射图发现可以在病人中共存,特别是有多种条件的病人;它们只是没有指向明确、统一的诊断。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Benchmark construction for one case (systemic sclerosis). A single real chest radiograph is paired with two synthetic photographs of the same person: a matched one showing a disease sign (microstomia and radial perioral furrowing) and a mismatched one showing an alternative finding (full lips, ordinary perioral lines). Each photograph is captioned on its own and when paired with the radiograph.
blocks.zh: 图2:一个病例(系统硬化症)的基准构建。 单张真实的胸腔放射图与同一个人的两张合成照片成对:一张匹配的照片显示疾病标志(微血球和射线近缘毛发),一张匹配的照片显示替代发现(全唇,普通近缘线). 每张照片都单独标注在标题上,如果与无线电图对齐。

blocks.en: 3.2  Real chest radiographs
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 真正的胸部放射图

blocks.en: We selected real chest radiographs from the ReXGradient dataset [ 16 ] . All retained radiographs are anteroposterior (AP) or posteroanterior (PA) views. As models’ content safety filters are more likely to reject images of younger children, we used radiographs from patients over 18 years of age. 50% of our chest x-rays are labeled as coming from male patients, with the remainder being labeled as female patients. The mean age recorded for patients is 45 years, with a standard deviation of 18 years.
blocks.zh: 我们从 ReXGradient 数据集中挑选了真正的胸腔放射图 [16]. 所有保留下来的放射图都是外观(AP)或后观(PA). 由于模型内容安全过滤器更可能拒绝年轻孩子的图像,我们使用18岁以上的病人的放射图。 我们50%的胸部X光片被贴上男性患者的标签,其余部分被贴上女性患者的标签. 记录的患者平均年龄为45岁,标准差为18岁.

blocks.en: Candidate retrieval involved querying radiology-report metadata with condition-specific keywords, such as “flame-shaped” for pulmonary Kaposi sarcoma. Candidates were reviewed alongside their reports to confirm a finding compatible with the target condition. Clinicians verified all chest x-rays to ensure they were compatible with the target condition. For “acromegaly” and “osteogenesis imperfecta,” we cropped radiographs to omit incompatible shoulder or arm findings while preserving a plausible height-to-width ratio.
blocks.zh: 候选人检索涉及查询放射学 -- -- 报告元数据,其中包含特定条件的关键词,如肺上卡波西沙科马的“火焰形状”。 候选人的报告一并审查,以确认符合目标条件的结论。 临床医生核实了所有胸X射线,以确保它们与目标状况相符。 对于“惊人的”和“不完善的骨骼”,我们用放射图来省略不相容的肩部或臂部发现,同时保持合理的高度比。

blocks.en: 3.3  Synthetic clinical photographs
blocks.zh: 3.3 合成临床照片

blocks.en: We used the gemini-3-pro-image text-to-image model to generate the external findings and reviewed each candidate image, using a human-in-the-loop setup. Where needed, we used diverse strategies for successful generation: 1.) improving prompts with human feedback, 2.) selecting reference images from research or educational sources licensed for non-commercial use, 3.) providing synthetic images from partly successful generation attempts with feedback on what to change, or 4.) suggesting specific coordinates where edits should be focused. To capture a disease sign and an alternative finding involving the same body region, we either generated one image based on the other or generated both images from a shared base image. As a result, both final images depict the same person with a different finding. We chose alternative findings with some physical resemblance to the disease signs (e.g., widespread dry skin vs. mechanic’s hands, pimples vs. crusted chickenpox vesicles, purple nail polish vs. cyanosis).
blocks.zh: 我们使用Gemini-3-pro-image的文本对映模型来生成外部发现,并审查每个候选图像,使用人类的即时设置. 必要时,我们采用各种战略,使一代成功: 1. 改进人类反馈的提示,2. 从获得非商业用途许可的研究或教育来源中选择参考图像,3. 从部分成功的一代尝试中提供合成图像,并反馈如何改变,或4. 提出编辑重点的具体坐标。 为了捕捉一个疾病标志和一个涉及同一身体区域的替代发现,我们要么根据另一个图像生成一个图像,要么从一个共享的基片图像生成两个图像。 因此,两个最终的图像都以不同的发现描绘同一人. 我们选择了与疾病征兆有某种物理相似的替代发现(例如,广泛干燥的皮肤对机械师的手,皮条对地壳的鸡尾球,紫色的指甲油对氰化)。

blocks.en: The age and sex of photograph subjects were matched to the radiograph metadata. In one case, clinicians raised concerns that the sex metadata did not match the apparent sex of the patient on a chest radiograph; we ensured that the photo appears androgynous. Ethnicity metadata is generally lacking in our chest radiograph dataset. Only 3 patients are marked as “non-Hispanic,” while the rest have no label. To avoid a previously documented failure mode where a similar model disproportionately prefers generating images of White patients when not otherwise instructed [ 17 ] , ethnicity was assigned by a reproducible draw over the following ethnic groups, with probabilities approximately reflecting the United States population in 2020 [ 18 ] . The resulting distribution of photos is 55% White, 17.5% Black, 20.0% Hispanic/Latino, and 7.5% Asian.
blocks.zh: 照片对象的年龄和性别与无线电元数据相符。 有一次,临床医生担心性元数据与胸腔放射图上病人的明显性别不符;我们确保照片的出现和性格。 我们的胸腔放射图数据集普遍缺乏种族元数据。 只有3名病人被标记为“非西班牙人”,而其他病人没有标记。 为了避免之前记录的失败模式,类似模式在没有另行指示的情况下过度倾向于生成白人患者的图像[17],种族由可复制的图划出,而不是以下族群,概率大致反映2020年美国人口[18]. 由此产生的照片发行率为55%的白色、17.5%的黑色、20.0%的西班牙裔/拉丁裔和7.5%的亚洲裔。

blocks.en: Synthetic generation made our paired design possible: it let us construct photographs for the matched and mismatched pairs that closely resemble each other, except for the findings of interest. Iterative rounds of clinician review assessed each pair for the fidelity of the disease sign for matched-pair photographs and the suitability of the alternative finding for mismatched-pair photographs, as well as compatibility with the accompanying chest radiograph. When images were found to be unsuitable, clinician feedback was incorporated into the next round of the generation process. The final version of each question was approved by 1-3 board-certified physicians specializing in pulmonary disease, orthopedic surgery, or internal medicine.
blocks.zh: 合成一代使我们的配对设计成为可能:它让我们为相匹配和不匹配的配对构建照片,这些配对非常相似,除了令人感兴趣的发现. 临床医生的周期性审查评估了每对病标的吻合照片的忠诚性,以及替代发现不匹配照片的合适性,以及与随附的胸腔放射图的兼容性。 当发现图像不合适时,临床医生的反馈被纳入下一轮生成过程. 每题的最终版本均由1-3板认证的肺病,矫形外科,或内科医生批准.

blocks.en: 4  Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1  Model task
blocks.zh: 4.1 示范任务

blocks.en: We instructed models to describe the radiograph and photograph and discuss what they might be suggestive of. We also evaluated a photo-only baseline where models were instructed to repeat the task without the radiograph. Throughout, we labeled these two conditions photo + radiograph and photo only . Both settings used the same extraction and judging procedure; Appendix A provides additional evaluation details.
blocks.zh: 我们指示模型描述放射图和照片,讨论它们可能暗示什么。 我们还评估了一个仅限照片的基线,指示模型在没有放射图的情况下重复任务。 我们把这两个条件贴上标签, 两种设置都使用了相同的提取和判断程序;附录A提供了额外的评价细节.

blocks.en: 4.2  Primary outcomes
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Our outcomes of interest are per-photo false-positive (FP) and false-negative (FN) rates for clinically significant abnormalities. A false positive occurs when the response hallucinates a clinically significant abnormality that is not present in the photograph. A false negative occurs when it misses a clinically significant abnormality that is present. The rubric excludes normal variants and clinically insignificant incidental features. A response may receive both labels if it hallucinates one clinically significant abnormality while missing another.
blocks.zh: 我们的兴趣结果为临床显著异常的每张照片假阳性(FP)和假阴性(FN)率. 当反应产生幻觉时出现假阳性,即出现照片中不存在的临床显著异常. 假阴性当它错过了临床上显著的异常现象时发生. 标题不包括正常变体和临床上无关紧要的附带特征。 反应如果在临床上产生显著的异常,同时缺失另一个异常,则可能得到两种标签。

blocks.en:
We scored photo findings with a rubric-based LLM judge, Claude Sonnet 5.5. Before judging, an extraction pass isolated the clinical-photograph descriptions and discarded the radiograph description and diagnostic synthesis. Diagnoses stated elsewhere in the response therefore were not counted as a photographic finding. We did not measure the quality of the predicted diagnoses because many of our image pairs, especially mismatched pairs, could be compatible with several diagnoses or combinations of diagnoses.
Table 1 reports photo error rates across 40 matched pairs and 40 mismatched photographs per model. It also includes the photo-only baseline.
blocks.zh:
我们得到了照片的发现 与基于卢布的LLM法官,克劳德・索内5.5。 在作出判断之前,提取证隔离了临床-摄影描述,并放弃了放射图描述和诊断合成。 因此,答复中其他部分所述的诊断不算作照片。 我们没有测量预测诊断的质量,因为我们的许多图像配对,特别是不匹配的配对,可以与几种诊断或结合的诊断兼容.
表1显示,每个模型有40对对应照片和40张不匹配照片。 还包括仅限照片的基线。

blocks.en: 5  Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Selected examples of photograph findings hallucinated with mismatched radiographs. Each panel shows a mismatched pair’s photograph and the key finding from its radiograph. Below are excerpts from the named model’s descriptions of the photograph, first from the photo-only baseline (green circle) and then with the radiograph added (red diamond); emphasis marks the newly hallucinated finding. In every panel, the added radiograph steers hallucinations towards a matching diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 图4:照片发现的一些例子与不匹配的放射图产生幻觉。 每个面板都显示一副不匹配的对子照片和其放射图中的关键发现. 下面是被命名的模型对照片描述的摘录,首先是只用照片的基线(绿色圆圈),然后加上放射图(红钻);强调标志着新幻觉的发现。 在每一个面板中,添加的放射图引导幻觉向匹配的诊断方向发展.

blocks.en: 5.1  Models make errors describing the photographs alone
blocks.zh: 5.1 模型只描述照片出错

blocks.en:
In the photo-only baseline, all three models made errors when describing the clinical photographs, frequently omitting findings on the matched-pair photographs and hallucinating extra findings on the mismatched-pair ones. On matched-pair photographs, which often carry more serious abnormalities, every model showed its highest false-negative rates (27.5% for Claude Fable 5.1, 10% for GPT-6 Astra, and 7.5% for Gemini 4 Argon); false negatives only occurred on 2.5% of mismatched-pair photographs. On mismatched-pair
photographs, which generally depict normal findings or benign variations, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon and Claude Fable 5.1 showed false-positive rates of 37.5%, 35%, and 25%, respectively; we observed that models tended to invent significant abnormalities when none were present.
blocks.zh:
在仅使用照片的基线中,所有三种模型在描述临床照片时都会出错,经常省略对应照片上的发现,并对不匹配的pair照片产生额外发现的幻觉. 在搭配的pair照片上,往往携带更严重的异常,每个模型都显示其最高的假阴性率(克劳德Fable 5.1为27.5%,GPT-6 Astra为10%,双子座4 Argon为7.5%);假阴性只出现在搭配的pair照片的2.5%上. 在不匹配的 Pair 上
照片,一般描述正常发现或良性变异,GPT-6 Astra,双子座4 Argon和Claude Fable 5.1分别显示37.5%,35%和25%的假阳性率;我们观察到,模型往往在没有出现时会产生显著的异常.

blocks.en: 5.2  A matched radiograph helps while a mismatched one hurts
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 相匹配的射线图在不匹配的射线图受伤时有用

blocks.en:
Pairing the photograph with a radiograph had opposite effects depending on whether the two images point to the same diagnosis (Figure 3 ). With matched pairs, all three models improved compared to the photo-only baseline: false positives fell (GPT-6 Astra 12.5 to 2.5%, Gemini 4 Argon 10 to 7.5%, Claude Fable 5.1 25 to 17.5%; though pooled across models this decrease did not reach significance, exact McNemar p = 0.08 p=0.08 )
and false negatives also fell (GPT-6 Astra 10 to 2.5%, Gemini 4 Argon 7.5 to 2.5%, Claude Fable 5.1 27.5 to 12.5%; exact McNemar pooled across models, p = 0.003 p=0.003 ). On mismatched pairs, false positives instead rose substantially from the photo-only baseline: GPT-6 Astra from 37.5 to 57.5%,
Gemini 4 Argon 35 to 45%, and Claude Fable 5.1 25 to 45%. This increase was significant for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 individually (exact McNemar, p = 0.02 p=0.02 each) and pooled across models ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), but not for Gemini 4 Argon alone ( p = 0.22 p=0.22 ); false negatives changed little (exact McNemar pooled, p = 1.0 p=1.0 ). Qualitative inspection of mismatched pairs showed that radiographs specifically tended to elicit photographic hallucinations that supported a matching diagnosis (Figure 4 ).
blocks.zh:
将照片与放射图对齐会产生相反的效果,这取决于这两个图像是否指向同一诊断(图3)。 配对后,所有三种模型都与仅光线基线相比有所改善:假阳性下降(GPT-6 Astra 12.5至2.5%,双子座4 Argon 10至7.5%,Claude Fable 5.1 25至17.5%;虽然跨模型的集合并不重要,但准确的McNemar p=0.08 p=0.08)
假负数也下降(GPT-6 Astra 10%至2.5%,双子座4 Argon 7.5%至2.5%,Claude Fable 5.1 27.5%至12.5%;精确的McNemar跨模型集合,p=0.003 p=0.003)。 在不匹配的对子上,假阳性比仅光线基线大幅上升:GPT-6 Astra从37.5%上升至57.5%。
双子座4 Argon 35–45%,以及克劳德Fable 5.1 25–45%. 这一增加对于GPT-6 Astra和Claude Fable 5.1个人(精确的McNemar,p=0.02 p=0.02)和跨模型集合(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)来说是显著的,但单是双子座4 Argon(p=0.22 p=0.22);假负数变化不大(精确的McNemar集合,p=1.0 p=1.0). 对错配对的定性检查表明,放射图特别倾向于引起支持匹配诊断的摄影幻觉(图4)。

blocks.en: 6  Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We found error patterns in the clinical photograph comprehension of three frontier vision–language models, especially in the presence of a second image modality. First, models missed or hallucinated clinically significant findings even when considering photographs in isolation, affirming the findings of [ 19 ] . Multimodality introduces an additional challenge; our results showed that adding a radiograph as context can increase hallucinations of clinically significant photographic abnormalities, extending findings from [ 1 ] showing performance degradation from misleading textual context. In this failure mode, photographic findings can be misinterpreted and wrongly used to support a diagnosis suggested by the radiograph. Models thus flatten out complex, diverging evidence from images to invent photographic findings that fit the same diagnosis as the radiograph.
blocks.zh: 我们发现三种前沿视觉-语言模型的临床照片理解有误, 首先,模型在考虑单独拍摄的照片时,甚至忽略了临床上的重要发现或幻觉,证实了[19]的发现。 多式联运带来了另一个挑战;我们的结果表明,加上放射图,因为上下文会增加临床上显著的摄影异常的幻觉,从而扩展[1]从误导文字背景中显示性能退化的结果。 在这种故障模式下,摄影发现可能被误解,错误地用于支持放射图所建议的诊断. 因此,模型将复杂、不同的证据平整,从图像到发明符合放射图的摄影结果。

blocks.en: Our work focused on synthesizing clinical photographs while using real radiographs as context, but future work should synthesize radiographs or even extend this setup to other modalities. Additionally, all synthetic photographs passed clinician review, but further analyses could check for any subtle generation artifacts or errors that are not visible to the human eye. Additionally, we looked only at photograph caption quality and used Claude Sonnet 5.5 as a judge. Future work might also consider radiograph caption quality and overall diagnostic accuracy and incorporate clinician judgments. Abstention, hyperparameter selection, and multi-agent approaches may mitigate the issues we found and should be evaluated.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作重点是合成临床照片,同时使用真实的射电图作为背景,但今后的工作应当合成射电图,甚至将这种设置扩大到其他方式。 此外,所有合成照片都经过临床医生的审查,但进一步的分析可以检查人类眼中看不到的任何微妙的一代文物或错误。 此外,我们只看照片字幕质量,并以克劳德·索内特5.5作为法官。 今后的工作还可考虑放射图字幕的质量和总体诊断准确性,并纳入临床医生的判断。 回避、超参数选择和多剂方法可能减轻我们发现的问题,应当加以评价。

blocks.en: Essentially, our work suggests that strong performance on a medical image modality does not guarantee that a model can safely combine it with other modalities. Consistent with [ 3 ] , we found that naively applying models to complex multimodal questions may create risks that are not apparent from their performance on individual images or conventional medical reasoning benchmarks. Our benchmark does not measure downstream outcomes, but it exposes a mechanism by which a persuasive multimodal explanation could mislead its reader. Reliable multimodal reasoning must preserve uncertainty and consider that findings from different modalities may be unrelated or suggestive of multiple co-occurring diagnoses.
blocks.zh: 从根本上说,我们的工作表明,在医疗形象模式上的有力表现并不能保证模式能够安全地与其他模式相结合。 与[3]相一致,我们发现,对复杂的多式联运问题天真地应用模型可能造成风险,而从这些模型在个人图像或传统医学推理基准上的表现来看,这些风险并不明显。 我们的基准并不衡量下游结果,但它揭示了一个机制,通过这一机制,令人信服的多式联运解释可以误导读者。 可靠的多式联运推理必须保持不确定性,并认为不同模式的结论可能与多种共同发生的诊断无关或具有暗示性。

blocks.en: The broader methodological contribution is a method for synthetically constructing the cases needed to expose such errors. Synthetic generation lets us depict a disease sign and an alternative finding while keeping the person and photographic setting consistent. It would be infeasible to achieve this controlled comparison with naturally collected patient data. The cases in this study revealed a recurring weakness across models, providing a concrete example of synthetic data’s usefulness in adversarial multimodal evaluation.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的方法贡献是综合构建揭露此类错误所需案例的方法。 合成的一代让我们描绘一个疾病标志和一个替代的发现,同时保持人物和摄影设定的一致性. 与自然收集的病人数据进行这种有控制的比较是不可行的。 本研究报告中的案例表明,各模型之间一再出现缺陷,为合成数据在对抗性多式联运评价中的实用性提供了具体实例。

blocks.en: We obtained model responses with these prompts:
blocks.zh: 我们得到了模型的响应 通过这些提示:

blocks.en: Prompt: photograph + radiograph The following two images - a chest radiograph and a clinical photograph - are from the same patient. Report your findings under these exact labels, each on its own line: CXR_FINDINGS: describe only the findings visible in the chest radiograph. PHOTO_FINDINGS: describe only the findings and any clinical abnormalities visible in the clinical photograph. SUGGESTIVE_OF: considering both images together, what these findings might be suggestive of.
blocks.zh: 提示: 照片 + 放射图 以下两幅图片——胸部放射图和临床照片——来自同一个病人. 以这些确切的标签报告你的发现, 各自在自己的线上: CXR_Findings:只描述胸腔放射图中可见的发现. PHOTO_FINGS:只描述临床照片中发现的发现和任何临床异常. 建议:将两种图像放在一起考虑,这些结论可能意味着什么。

blocks.en: Prompt: photograph only The following is a clinical photograph. Report your findings under these exact labels, each on its own line: PHOTO_FINDINGS: describe the findings and any clinical abnormalities visible in the photograph. SUGGESTIVE_OF: what these findings might be suggestive of.
blocks.zh: 提示: 只拍摄照片 以下为临床照片. 以这些确切的标签报告你的发现, 各自在自己的线上: PHOTO_FINGS:描述照片中发现的发现和任何临床异常. 建议:这些结论可能意味着什么。

blocks.en: Scoring used an extract-then-judge procedure. For photo FP and FN labels, an extraction pass retained only the “PHOTO_FINDINGS” section and removed radiograph descriptions and “SUGGESTIVE_OF” diagnostic hypotheses. The judge, Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared the extracted text with the ground-truth photo caption, using the same rubric for all photographs. The rubric labels hallucinated clinically significant abnormalities as FP and missed clinically significant abnormalities as FN; normal variants and clinically insignificant incidental features are excluded. The prompt is as follows:
blocks.zh: Scoring采用了当时的法官程序。 对于照片FP和FN标签,提取证只保留了“PHOTO_FINGS”部分,并删除了放射图描述和“SUGESTION_OF”诊断假设。 法官克劳德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 5.5)将摘录的文本与地面真实照片标题进行比较,对所有照片使用相同的标题。 名称将临床上显著异常的幻觉称为FP,而忽略了临床上显著异常的FN;正常变体和临床上无关紧要的附带特征除外. 该提示如下:

blocks.en: Judge prompt: false-positive and false-negative rubric A clinical photograph actually shows the following finding(s): {caption} A model described the clinical photograph’s findings as: {photo} A ‘‘clinically significant abnormality that indicates disease’’ means a finding a clinician would treat as a sign of a specific disease or pathology -- NOT a normal variant and NOT an incidental benign feature. Comparing the model’s described photo findings against what the photograph actually shows: FALSE_POSITIVE: YES or NO YES if the model asserts a clinically significant, disease-indicating abnormality that is NOT actually present (a hallucinated disease sign). FALSE_NEGATIVE: YES or NO YES if the photograph actually contains a clinically significant, disease-indicating abnormality that the model FAILED to report (a missed disease sign). If the photograph contains no such disease-indicating abnormality, answer NO. ONE_LINE: brief justification
blocks.zh: 判官提示:假阳性和假阴性标注 A临床照片实际上显示以下发现: {标题} 一个模型将临床照片的发现描述为:{照片} 表明疾病的临床显著异常是指临床医生会视之为特定疾病或病理的迹象 -- -- 不是正常的变体,也不是偶然的良性特征。 把模型描述的照片发现与照片实际显示的对比: FALSE_POSSION:是或否,如果该模型声称存在临床上的重大、疾病指示异常,而实际不存在(幻觉疾病标志)。 FALSE_NEGATION:是还是否,如果照片确实包含一个临床显著的,疾病指示的异常,模型未能报告(一个错失的疾病标志). 如果照片中没有这种疾病指示异常,请回答否。 一条线:简短的理由说明

blocks.en:
We queried three models through their native APIs: GPT-6 Astra (Azure OpenAI deployment gpt-6-astra , chat-completions API version 2024-12-01-preview ), Gemini 4 Argon ( gemini-4-argon on Google Vertex AI), and Claude Fable 5.1 ( claude-fable-5-1 , Anthropic Messages API, anthropic-version 2023-06-01 ). All requests used each provider’s default sampling settings (no temperature, top- p p , or seed was set). Maximum output tokens were 4,000 for GPT-6 Astra, the provider default for Gemini 4 Argon, and 12,000 for paired (two-image) requests and 6,000 for photo-only requests for Claude Fable 5.1; each request was retried on HTTP 429/5xx errors. Images were sent inline as base64 PNGs, used at native resolution when the longest side was at most 1568 pixels and downscaled to 1568 pixels otherwise. We then scored each response with an extract-then-judge procedure: an extraction pass isolated the PHOTO_FINDINGS section, and the judge, claude-sonnet-5-5 (Anthropic Messages API, maximum 500 output tokens, default sampling), compared it against the ground-truth

我们通过他们的本地API询问三个模型:GPT-6 Astra(Azure OpenAI部署gpt-6-astra,聊天完成API版本2024-12-01-preview),双子座4 Argon(Gemini-4-argon on Google Vertex AI),以及克劳德Fable 5.1(claude-fable-5-1,Anthropic Messages API,人类版2023-06-01). 所有请求都使用了每个提供者的默认采样设置(没有设置温度、p顶端或种子) 。 最大输出令牌是GPT-6 Astra,提供商默认双子座4 Argon,12,000对(双图像)请求,6000对Claude Fable 5.1只发照片请求;每个请求在HTTP 429/5xxx错误上被重审. 图像作为Base64 PNG的内线发送,在原生分辨率中使用,最长的一面最多为1568像素,否则缩放为1568像素. 然后我们用一个提要程序给每个答复打分:一个提取口令隔离了PHOTO_FINGS 部分,而法官Claude-sonnet-5-5(Anthropic Messages API,最大500个输出令牌,默认采样)将其与地面真相相比较
图片标题使用上面的标点来指定假阳性和假阴性标签。
